_about: Victorian election model (.build/analysis/seat-model/vic-simulate.mjs): 20,000 simulated elections for Saturday 28 November 2026, 88 Assembly seats. The federal 2028 model's engine and fitted errors on Victoria's 2022 district counts, the /vic/ polling average, One Nation added in every district at its federal 2025 footprint, preferences from the 2025 Senate ballots at the nearest federal polling place (House-calibrated), each group's Labor-v-Coalition level set to its last measured Victorian count (Greens and minor parties: the 2022 state count; One Nation: the 2025 federal count in Victoria); no federal vote-switching mix. HARD LIMITS: the 2022 candidate field is assumed (plus One Nation); no age/gender term; by-elections and defections since 2022 are not in the base; the Legislative Council is not modelled.

national.headline: The Coalition is favoured to win the most seats, with a majority about as likely as not
